title: Visha-Video Player All Formats
summary: Visha Player provides an uninterrupted video experience without any ads.
description:
Visha is a practical and stylish app with powerful local video and audio playback capabilities. In addition, you can also watch online videos, download favorite videos and audios, and have a wide range of custom skins to choose from.
Key features are as follows:
■ Hide videos to the hidden Privacy Folder
- Hide your secret videos to your private folder and protect your privacy
■ Edit Video：
- Video cut
■ Play Video：
-Browse all your local video files and play status videos, trailers, movies and any other videos stored in your device.
- Classify videos by downloading sources to help you find videos quickly.
- Background play function
- Floating play function
- playback speed control
- History List
- Support double click to fast forward and fast backward.
- Auto pause mode after playback.
-Multiple audio tracks for videos
- Subtitle downloads
■ Play Music：
- Locate and manage all audio files from your phone memory and SD card
- Audio timer for auto-shutdown
- Audio file filtering and sorting
- Audio equalizer
■ online Video：
- Online video content from multiple countries, including movies, TV shows, and variety shows
-Collect exciting TV shows and programs
-VIP membership exclusive privileges: ad-free viewing, exclusive content, HD mode (1080P)...
■ Download：
- Video downloads
- Audio downloads
■Personalization features:
Customizable skins
Convert video to MP3
